title: eludite.browser.devtools input
description: Open Chromium's DevTools for a tab (default: the active tab) as a second tab of the Web Browser window, bound to the page: the person's view of the elements, console, network and sources, as F12 and the window's DevTools button open it. With `inspect`, DevTools selects the element at that point (the context menu's Inspect). It closes with its page. Needs the embedded engine (browser.engine: embedded); with the external Chrome the command fails and says so. An agent reads the page itself with eludite.browser.read_page, console and network; this is for showing the person. Permission class execute.

inspect.description: Inspect the element at this point, in CSS pixels of the viewport.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
